description: Write acceptance tests for the geo module in test/acceptance/geo.test.js from .hub/spec.md and the interface JSDoc only (do not read or rely on implementation details). Cover documented behavior, exact strings, error classes and codes, and edge cases. No network: inject fake fetch, sources and routers. Tests may fail until the module is built.
summary: 38 acceptance tests in test/acceptance/geo.test.js (commit 3685971 on build/geo-tests-1), one per documented promise of src/geo.js: haversine, lineLengthM, pointToPolylineM, positionAlongM clamping, camerasNearRoute (filter, inclusive buffer, order, id tie-break, no mutation), bboxAround/Contains/Union, circleRing, polyline encode/decode (Google example at p5 and p6, round trips). Distances checked to the spec's 1% target, exact results exactly. Checked against an independent scratch reference (passes, including circumscribed-ring and planar-along variants) and 12 deliberately broken variants (each caught). Against the current stub all fail with NotImplementedError except EARTH_RADIUS_M, as expected. Decisions geo-tests.1-3.
title: Acceptance tests for geometry helpers
